positions.title: Sr. Database Administrator
positions.description: We're seeking an experienced Sr. Database Administrator to ensure the integrity, security, and HIPAA-compliant protection of our enterprise and patient data. You will design, maintain, and optimize pharmacy databases and integrations across our technology platforms.
duties: Ensure the integrity, security, and HIPAA-compliant protection of enterprise and patient data through access controls, encryption, backups, and continuous monitoring across servers, databases, and data transfers
Design, maintain, and optimize pharmacy databases and integrations with EHR, POS, inventory, billing, Micro Merchant, Medistics, 340B (Cumulus), and DME platforms
Troubleshoot performance, connectivity, and data issues across all integrated systems
Create and maintain the database schema, including tables, indexes, views, and relationships to efficiently store pharmacy data such as patient information, prescriptions, inventory, and billing
Ensure seamless data integration with Electronic Health Records (EHR), Point of Sale (POS) systems, and inventory management systems
requirements: Master's degree or foreign equivalent in Business Analytics, Computer Information Systems, Computer Science, or Computer Engineering
One (1) year of experience as Sr. Database Administrator or Database Administrator performing the listed job duties
